rows.label: Before applying, finish two FGSS courses with at least a C-minus
rows.note: A grade floor and a gate on applying to the major; the board cannot see grades, so confirm it yourself.

rows.label: Six more FGSS courses beyond the three core courses (nine in all)
rows.note: The nine-course total includes the three core seats, so six more remain. Counted at the 2000 level or above and at 3 or more credits only, since the page says first-year writing seminars do not count toward the major and each course is 3 or 4 credits. The honors thesis courses (FGSS 4990 and 4991) are excluded, because the page treats them as extra work on top of the courses that satisfy the major.

rows.label: Every one of the nine FGSS courses needs a grade of at least C-minus
rows.note: The board cannot see grades; confirm them yourself.
